# Bellevue Dispatch

> The Bellevue Dispatch is a free weekly email newsletter about Bellevue, WA, sent Thursdays at 6 AM Pacific and published by Neighborhood Press LLC. It covers city council decisions, land-use and permit notices, road and transit changes, school district news, openings and closings, with one section per neighborhood. Every item links its public source. It is researched and written with AI tools, and an editor reads every issue before it goes out.

## Key pages
- [This week in Bellevue](https://www.bellevuedispatch.com/this-week/): the dated items for the current week, updated every Thursday
- [Bellevue news](https://www.bellevuedispatch.com/news/): every story, newest first
- [Reader asked](https://www.bellevuedispatch.com/asked/): readers' questions answered from the public record
- [Standards](https://www.bellevuedispatch.com/standards/): publisher, sources, sponsors, corrections
- [Subscribe](https://www.bellevuedispatch.com/): free, one email a week

## Neighborhoods
- [Bridle Trails](https://www.bellevuedispatch.com/bridle-trails/): Equestrian trails, the 482-acre state park, and quiet streets between Kirkland and downtown Bellevue.
- [BelRed](https://www.bellevuedispatch.com/belred/): The Spring District, the 2 Line stations, and the fastest-changing blocks in the city.
- [Cougar Mountain / Lakemont](https://www.bellevuedispatch.com/cougar-mountain-lakemont/): Hillside streets above Lewis Creek Park with trailheads into the Cougar Mountain Regional Wildland Park.
- [Crossroads](https://www.bellevuedispatch.com/crossroads/): The mall, the farmers market, the international food court, and the park across the street.
- [Downtown](https://www.bellevuedispatch.com/downtown/): Towers, the Downtown Park, the Grand Connection plan, and the Bellevue Transit Center.
- [Eastgate](https://www.bellevuedispatch.com/eastgate/): Along I-90 by Bellevue College, with Eastgate Park and the Mountains to Sound Greenway.
- [Factoria](https://www.bellevuedispatch.com/factoria/): The Marketplace at Factoria, Newport Way, and the Coal Creek trail corridor.
- [Lake Hills](https://www.bellevuedispatch.com/lake-hills/): Larsen Lake, the blueberry farm, the greenbelt trail, and the Lake Hills Boulevard corridor.
- [Newport](https://www.bellevuedispatch.com/newport/): Newport Shores, Newport Hills, and the shoreline along the south end of Lake Washington.
- [Northeast Bellevue](https://www.bellevuedispatch.com/northeast-bellevue/): Between 148th and the Redmond line, with Ardmore Park and the Bel-Red corridor to the south.
- [Northwest Bellevue](https://www.bellevuedispatch.com/northwest-bellevue/): Between downtown and Lake Washington's east shore, north of NE 8th.
- [Somerset](https://www.bellevuedispatch.com/somerset/): The hillside above I-90 with lake and skyline views and Somerset Recreation Club at its center.
- [West Bellevue](https://www.bellevuedispatch.com/west-bellevue/): Meydenbauer Bay, Clyde Hill's edge, and the streets between downtown and the lake.
- [West Lake Sammamish](https://www.bellevuedispatch.com/west-lake-sammamish/): The parkway, the lakefront, and Weowna Park's ravine trails.
- [Wilburton](https://www.bellevuedispatch.com/wilburton/): The trestle, Eastrail, the Botanical Garden, and the land-use plan reshaping the area east of 405.
- [Woodridge](https://www.bellevuedispatch.com/woodridge/): The hill south of downtown with Woodridge Water Tower Park and views across I-90.
